column3: The Hebrew explicitly names His face and songs in the plural; BSB says presence and song.
The Hebrew joins His making the sea with and rather than for as BSB does.
The Hebrew names the sheep of His hand; BSB says under His care.
The Hebrew has your heart in the singular; BSB has hearts.
The Hebrew says also they saw My work; BSB says though they had seen it.
The Hebrew has heart in the singular and says a generation without the added that in BSB.
The Hebrew does not explicitly add never as BSB does.
